examples.text: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti
musāvādā veramaṇī, pisuṇāya vācāya veramaṇī, pharusāya vācāya veramaṇī, samphappalāpā veramaṇī, ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave sammāvācā

60511.meaning1: frivolous chatter; talking rubbish; gossip; idle speech

examples.text: samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato ahosiṃ, kālavādī bhūtavādī atthavādī dhammavādī vinayavādī nidhānavatiṃ vācaṃ bhāsitā ahosiṃ kālena sāpadesaṃ pariyantavatiṃ atthasaṃhitaṃ.
samphappalāpaṃ pahāya samphappalāpā paṭivirato hoti

60512.meaning1: dependent on frivolous chatter; due to talking rubbish

examples.text: idha, bhikkhave, ekacco… sahā'pi dukkhena sahā'pi domanassena samphappalāpī hoti, samphappalāpapaccayā ca dukkhaṃ domanassaṃ paṭisaṃvedeti

60513.meaning1: frivolous chatter; talking rubbish; gossip; idle speech

examples.text: ahañ'c'eva kho pana paraṃ samphabhāsena samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyyaṃ, parassa'pi taṃ assa appiyaṃ amanāpaṃ. yo kho my'āyaṃ dhammo appiyo amanāpo, parassa peso dhammo appiyo amanāpo.

60516.meaning1: who chatters frivolously; who talks rubbish; who gossips

examples.text: taṃ kiṃ maññasi, gāmaṇi, idh'assa puriso pāṇ'ātipātī adinn'ādāyī kāmesumicchācārī musāvādī pisuṇavāco pharusavāco samphappalāpī abhijjhālu byāpannacitto micchādiṭṭhiko.
pare samphappalāpī bhavissanti, mayam'ettha samphappalāpā paṭiviratā bhavissāmā'ti sallekho karaṇīyo.
puna caparaṃ, gahapatayo, ariyasāvako iti paṭisañcikkhati, yo kho maṃ samphabhāsena samphappalāpabhāsena samudācareyya, na m'etaṃ assa piyaṃ manāpaṃ.

60518.meaning1: its own fruit; one's own fruit

examples.text: lobho doso ca moho ca, purisaṃ pāpacetasaṃ, hiṃsanti attasambhūtā, tacasāraṃ'va sam'phalan'ti
yo'pi hetu yo'pi paccayo kāyasamphassassa uppādāya, so'pi hetu so'pi paccayo anicco vipariṇāmī aññathābhāvī. aniccaṃ kho pana, bhikkhave, paccayaṃ paṭicca uppanno kāyasamphasso kuto nicco bhavissati!
khamā bhavissāma sītassa uṇhassa jighacchāya pipāsāya ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassānaṃ duruttānaṃ durāgatānaṃ vacanapathānaṃ
tañ'ce, āvuso, bhikkhuṃ pare aniṭṭhehi akantehi amanāpehi samudācaranti, pāṇisamphassena'pi leḍḍusamphassena'pi daṇḍasamphassena'pi satthasamphassena'pi.

60521.meaning1: produced by contact (with); caused by impression (of); born from experience

examples.text: cakkhusamphassajā… sotasamphassajā… ghānasamphassajā… jivhāsamphassajā… kāyasamphassajā… manosamphassajā vedanā loke piyarūpaṃ sātarūpaṃ, etth'esā taṇhā uppajjamānā uppajjati, ettha nivisamānā nivisati
tattha katamaṃ domanassaṃ? yaṃ cetasikaṃ asātaṃ, cetasikaṃ dukkhaṃ, cetosamphassajaṃ asātaṃ dukkhaṃ vedayitaṃ, cetosamphassajā asātā dukkhā vedanā.

60525.grammar: prp of pass of saṃ √phus, pass, intrans (+instr)

examples.text: yadi rājaporisena yadi sipp'aññatarena, sītassa purakkhato uṇhassa purakkhato ḍaṃsa-makasa-vāt'ātapa-sarīsapa-samphassehi samphassamāno khuppipāsāya mīyamāno, ayaṃ, bhikkhave, kāmānaṃ ādīnavo sandiṭṭhiko dukkhakkhandho kāmahetu kāmanidānaṃ kām'ādhikaraṇaṃ kāmānam'eva hetu.

60530.meaning1: field of experience; fields of sense impressions

examples.text: chaphass'āyatano ayaṃ, bhikkhu, puriso'ti, iti kho pan'etaṃ vuttaṃ. kiñ'c'etaṃ paṭicca vuttaṃ? cakkhusamphass'āyatanaṃ, sotasamphass'āyatanaṃ, ghānasamphass'āyatanaṃ, jivhāsamphass'āyatanaṃ, kāyasamphass'āyatanaṃ, manosamphass'āyatanaṃ.

60531.commentary: (MNa) āmakacchinno'ti atitaruṇakāle chinno, so hi vāt'ātapena saṃphusati c'eva milāyati ca.

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena samphuṭito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi samphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

60532.meaning1: touched; contacted; had a close relationship with

examples.text: sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati.
ye'me pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.

60533.meaning1: experienced before; which previously left an impression

examples.text: ye'me pañca kāmaguṇā cetaso samphuṭṭhapubbā atītā niruddhā vipariṇatā, tatra me cittaṃ bahulaṃ gacchamānaṃ gaccheyya paccuppannesu vā appaṃ vā anāgatesu.

60536.meaning1: touching intimately; coming into close contact

examples.text: kiṃ te aparādhitaṃ mayā, yaṃ maṃ ovariyāna tiṭṭhasi, na hi pabbajitāya āvuso, puriso samphusanāya kappati.

60537.meaning1: touching; contacting; associating; having a close relationship with

examples.text: sevamāno sevamānaṃ, samphuṭṭho samphusaṃ paraṃ, saro diddho kalāpaṃ'va, alittam'upalimpati. upalepabhayā dhīro, n'eva pāpasakhā siyā.

60539.meaning2: touched, come in contact with, well fitted

examples.text: seyyathā'pi nāma tittak'ālābu āmakacchinno vāt'ātapena samphusito hoti sammilāto, evam'ev'assu me sīsacchavi saṃphuṭitā hoti sammilātā tāy'ev'app'āhāratāya.

60540.meaning1: to touch; to bring into contact (with)
60540.commentary: (SNPa) pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche, kutonena saṃvasitun'ti.

examples.text: disvāna taṇhaṃ aratiṃ ragañ'ca, n'āhosi chando api methunasmiṃ, kim'ev'idaṃ muttakarīsapuṇṇaṃ, pādā'pi naṃ samphusituṃ na icche.

bhoto kho dāne evarūpaṃ bhojanaṃ dīyati kaṇājakaṃ bilaṅgadutiyaṃ, yaṃ bhavaṃ pādā'pi na iccheyya samphusituṃ, kuto bhuñjituṃ, dhorakāni ca vatthāni guḷavālakāni, yāni bhavaṃ pādā'pi na iccheyya samphusituṃ, kuto paridahituṃ.

60541.meaning2: having touched, having come in contact with

60543.commentary: (THa) sambaddho'ti taṇhābandhanena baddho. ayaṃ me putto, mātā'ti-ādinā paṭibaddho. ayam'eva vā pāṭho, ime maṃ posenti, ahaṃ ime nissāya jīvāmī'ti paṭibaddhacitto'ti attho.

examples.text: jano janamhi sambaddho, janam'ev'assito jano, jano janena heṭhīyati, heṭheti ca jano janaṃ.

60549.meaning1: with a tie; having a bond; having a thing which binds
60549.commentary: (UDa) mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissatī'ti… so'pi mohasambandhano mohena paliguṇṭhito attahit'āhitaṃ ajānanto hite na paṭipajjati, ahitaṃ dukkh'āvahaṃ bahuñ'ca apuññaṃ ācināti.

examples.text: mohasambandhano loko, bhabbarūpo'va dissati, upadhibandhano bālo, tamasā parivārito, sassato'riva khāyati, passato n'atthi kiñcanan'ti.
atha kho jīvako komārabhacco seṭṭhiṃ gahapatiṃ mañcake nipātetvā sambandhitvā sīsacchaviṃ uppāṭetvā sibbiniṃ vināmetvā dve pāṇake nīharitvā mahājanassa dassesi.

60553.commentary: (SNa) sambaro'va sataṃ saman'ti yathā sambaro asur'indo māyāvī māyaṃ payojetvā vassasataṃ niraye pakko, evaṃ paccati. tumhe dhammikā'va, alaṃ vo māyāyā'ti vadati. kiṃ pana sakko tassa kodhaṃ tikicchituṃ sakkuṇeyyā'ti? āma sakkuṇeyya. kathaṃ? tadā kira so isigaṇo dharati'y'eva, tasmā naṃ isīnaṃ santikaṃ netvā khamāpeyya, evam'assa phāsu bhaveyya. tena pana vañcitattā tathā akatvā pakkanto'va.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, te isayo sīlavanto kalyāṇadhammā, seyyathā'pi nāma balavā puriso samiñjitaṃ vā bāhaṃ pasāreyya, pasāritaṃ vā bāhaṃ samiñjeyya evam'eva, samuddatīre paṇṇakuṭīsu antarahitā sambarassa asur'indassa sammukhe pāturahesuṃ.

60554.commentary: (SNt) sambarimāyan'ti sambarena asur'indena uppāditaṃ asuramāyaṃ, yaṃ indajālan'ti'pi vuccati indassa mohan'atthaṃ uppāditattā.

examples.text: atha kho, bhikkhave, vepacitti asur'indo asure paṭipucchi, vācem'ahaṃ, mārisā, sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ sambarimāyan'ti? mā kho tvaṃ, mārisa, vācesi sakkaṃ devānam'indaṃ sambarimāyan'ti.

60556.meaning1: provisions for a journey; food for the road; snack; padkos

examples.text: seyyathā'pi, bhikkhave, dve jāyam'patikā parittaṃ sambalaṃ ādāya kantāramaggaṃ paṭipajjeyyuṃ

60557.meaning1: quantity of supplies for a journey

examples.text: tesam'assa ekaputtako piyo manāpo. atha kho tesaṃ, bhikkhave, dvinnaṃ jāyam'patikānaṃ kantāragatānaṃ yā parittā sambalamattā, sā parikkhayaṃ pariyādānaṃ gaccheyya. siyā ca nesaṃ kantār'āvaseso anatiṇṇo.
atha kho sambahulā bhikkhuniyo yen'āyasmā ānando ten'upasaṅkamiṃsu
tena kho pana samayena sambahulehi bhikkhūhi bhagavato santike aññā byākatā hoti, khīṇā jāti, vusitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ, kataṃ karaṇīyaṃ, n'āparaṃ itthattāyā'ti pajānāmā'ti.

60563.meaning1: with a luxurious lifestyle; living in excess

examples.text: puna caparaṃ, nigrodha, tapassī aññataraṃ samaṇaṃ vā brāhmaṇaṃ vā apasādetā hoti, kiṃ pan'āyaṃ sambahul'ājīvo sabbaṃ saṃbhakkheti.
yo pana bhikkhu saṅghike vihāre jānaṃ pubb'upagataṃ bhikkhuṃ anupakhajja seyyaṃ kappeyya, yassa sambādho bhavissati, so pakkamissatī'ti etadeva paccayaṃ karitvā anaññaṃ, pācittiyaṃ.
sambādho ghar'āvāso raj'āpatho, abbhokāso pabbajjā. na'y'idaṃ sukaraṃ agāraṃ ajjhāvasatā ek'antaparipuṇṇaṃ ek'antaparisuddhaṃ saṅkhalikhitaṃ brahmacariyaṃ carituṃ.

60565.meaning1: confinement; captivity; cramped place; obstruction; difficult passage
60565.commentary: (ANa) sambādhe'ti pañcakāmaguṇasambādhe. (SNa) sambādhe'ti nīvaraṇasambādhaṃ kāmaguṇasambādhan'ti dve sambādhā. tesu idha nīvaraṇasambādhaṃ adhippetaṃ.

examples.text: acchariyaṃ, āvuso, abbhutaṃ, āvuso! yāvañ'c'idaṃ tena bhagavatā jānatā passatā arahatā sammāsambuddhena sambādhe okās'ādhigamo anubuddho sattānaṃ visuddhiyā sokaparidevānaṃ samatikkamāya dukkhadomanassānaṃ atthaṅ'gamāya ñāyassa adhigamāya nibbānassa sacchikiriyāya.
sambādhe vata okāsaṃ, avindi bhūrimedhaso, yo jhānam'abujjhi buddho, paṭilīnanisabho munī'ti.

60566.commentary: (ANa) bahū hi tattha sambādhā'ti tasmiṃ sāmaññasaṅkhāte ariyamagge bahū sambādhā magg'ādhigamāya paṭipannassa pubbabhāge bahū parissayā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: dukkaraṃ duttitikkhañ'ca, abyattena ca sāmaññaṃ, bahūhi sambādhā, yattha bālo visīdatī'ti.

60567.commentary: (VINa) sambādhe'ti paṭicchann'okāse. tassa vibhāgadassan'atthaṃ pana ubho upakacchakā muttakaraṇan'ti vuttaṃ.

examples.text: na gīvāya na aṃsehi, na udarena na piṭṭhiyā, na soṇiyā na urasā, na sambādhe na methune.
kathañ'hi nāma, bhikkhave, chabbaggiyā bhikkhuniyo sambādhe lomaṃ saṃharāpessanti!

60568.meaning1: more cramped; more confined; more hemmed-in (than)

examples.text: atthi kho no, bhante, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti. katamo pana vo, thapatayo, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti?

60570.meaning1: I have fallen into captivity; I have got into trouble

examples.text: namo te buddha vīr'atthu, vippamutto'si sabbadhi, sambādhapaṭipanno'smi, tassa me saraṇaṃ bhavā'ti.

60571.meaning1: with crowded alleyways; with congested markets
60571.commentary: (SNa) sambādhabyūhan'ti byūhā vuccanti avinibbiddharacchāyo, yā paviṭṭhamaggen'eva niggacchanti, tā sambādhā byūhā bahukā etthā'ti sambādhabyūhaṃ.

examples.text: ekam'antaṃ nisinno kho mahānāmo sakko bhagavantaṃ etadavoca, idaṃ, bhante, kapilavatthu iddhañ'c'eva phītañ'ca bāhujaññaṃ ākiṇṇamanussaṃ sambādhabyūhaṃ.

60573.meaning1: considered to be more cramped; reckoned to be more hemmed-in (than)

examples.text: atthi kho no, bhante, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti. katamo pana vo, thapatayo, etamhā sambādhā añño sambādho sambādhataro c'eva sambādhasaṅkhātataro cā'ti?

60579.commentary: (DNa) sambāhanan'ti mahāmallānaṃ viya hatthapāde muggar'ādīhi paharitvā bāhuvaḍḍhanaṃ. (ANt) sambāhanaṃ parimaddanaṃ.

examples.text: api ca kho mātugāmassa ucchādana-parimadda-nanhāpana-sambāhanaṃ sādiyati.

60582.meaning2: having massaged, having rubbed, having shampooed

examples.text: attha cakkhumā puriso tīre ṭhito passeyya sippikasambukam'pi sakkharakathalam'pi macchagumbam'pi carantam'pi tiṭṭhantam'pi

60589.meaning2: having understood clearly, having known perfectly

60590.meaning1: Awakened One; Buddha; who is wide awake; who has completely understood

examples.text: tato ca kāḷo pakkāmi, nadiṃ nerañjaraṃ pati, so addasāsi sambuddhaṃ, desentaṃ amataṃ padaṃ.
araññe rukkhamūle vā, suññ'āgāre'va bhikkhavo, anussaretha sambuddhaṃ, bhayaṃ tumhāka no siyā.

60591.meaning1: fully understood; completely comprehended; awakened; enlightened

examples.text: manussabhūtaṃ sambuddhaṃ, attadantaṃ samāhitaṃ, iriyamānaṃ brahmapathe, cittass'ūpasame rataṃ.
ye jhānapasutā dhīrā, nekkhamm'ūpasame ratā, devā'pi tesaṃ pihayanti, sambuddhānaṃ satīmataṃ.

60593.commentary: (SNa) sambuddhimantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññī'ti, sammā buddhimā vatasampanno ayan'ti evaṃ maññamāno kappo tava antevāsiko ahosiṃ ahaṃ so tena samayenā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: kappo ca te baddhacaro ahosiṃ, sambuddhimantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññi, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmī'ti.

60594.commentary: (SNa) sambuddhimantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññī'ti, sammā buddhimā vatasampanno ayan'ti evaṃ maññamāno kappo tava antevāsiko ahosiṃ ahaṃ so tena samayenā'ti dasseti.

examples.text: kappo ca te baddhacaro ahosiṃ, sambuddhivantaṃ vatinaṃ amaññi, taṃ te purāṇaṃ vatasīlavattaṃ, suttappabuddho'va anussarāmī'ti.

60595.meaning1: is capable to completely comprehend; is worthy to fully understand

60596.meaning1: to fully understand; to completely comprehend; to wake up to

examples.text: bhavarāgaparetehi, bhavasot'ānusāribhi, māradheyy'ānupannehi, n'āyaṃ dhammo susambudho.
